job_story: When I am ill on a working day, I want to tell all affected owners at once, so I can rest without spending an hour on messages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a walker has 6 walks booked today When the walker marks today as a day off Then all 6 walks are listed as affected within 2 seconds; Given the affected walks list is shown When the walker confirms Then one SMS per owner is queued within 60 seconds

job_story: When a walk is cancelled, I want to be offered a replacement time, so I can keep my dog's routine.
acceptance_criteria: Given an owner received a day-off SMS with an offered slot When the owner taps accept within 72 hours Then the replacement walk appears in the walker's week view within 60 seconds

job_story: When I review my week, I want to see which cancelled walks still need a decision, so I can follow up before the weekend.
acceptance_criteria: Given an owner has not replied for 24 hours When the walker opens the week view Then the walk is shown in the needs-attention strip

job_story: When I come back from a day off, I want to see a summary of what changed, so I can plan tomorrow.
